title: Local drummers today and keeping a satisfied mind in the band
summary: Royal Foster and Rudolph drumming; Mosley will not play with fellows who upset the band, saying a band needs a satisfied mind.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: We interviewed him. Yeah, yeah, he used to play in there. He loves drums. Yeah, he likes to play some drums. Yeah, yeah, he tried to play everything. He loves drums. But he never make a drummer. I tell you, you got a lot of them around here that never make it. Been playing the four hours. This fellow Rudolph, he played over there last Sunday. You saw him? Big Rudolph. You saw him last Sunday? Well, they wanted me to play, but after they had him, I can't play with them fellas. They asked me first, but I got that other fella, Bigfoot Bill, with him. I sent him on that job. But I can't play with them fellas, you know. They worry me. Mess me up. I thought he had Alfred, you see. I didn't build many kinds of it, because I played bass drum with Alfred. Yeah. But them other fellas, they didn't. Them the contraro too, you know. You see, playing music, you got to have a satisfied mind. Everybody be pleasant. But if any time you just satisfied like that, things ain't going to go right. You got to have a satisfied mind. And you got to have a mind. You got to have a satisfied mind. You got to have a mind.
That's all what you're doing. Otherwise, things ain't going to go right.
